_note: Secret Vault wooden gate timings, in seconds. shut_s: the fade-out, the halves swinging shut; the fade-in is a last rattle for hold_s, then the halves swing open over open_s. The stage counts as in view cover_at (part of the opening) into it, the halves nearly edge-on at the sides.

rattle._note: after the thud, for length_s: the halves bounce back by bounce (part of shut), decaying at bounce_decay per second, at bounce_freq radians per second; the seam rattles sideways by wobble, decaying at wobble_decay, at wobble_freq
